import os
for name in ('OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','OMP_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS'):os.environ[name]='1'
import numpy as np,json,hashlib,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.linalg import eigh,expm
import physical_c_bare_electric_loops as loops
alpha=loops.alpha;b=loops.background((2,1,1));profile=b['a']/np.sqrt(b['normE']);law=loops.make_law(.04,b)
nodes=np.array([-.3,0,.3]);w=np.array([.25,.5,.25]);beta=100.;width=3.5;ua=2.;N=4
states=[]
for a in nodes:
 p=law.potential(a*profile/np.sqrt(beta),b['phi'],b['links'],(profile/np.sqrt(beta),profile/np.sqrt(beta)))
 e,r=eigh(p['h']);states.append((p,e,r))
origin=states[1][2][:,N:];frames=[];tangents=[];weighted=[];sf=[];vac=[];direct_t=[]
h,masks=alpha.second_quantized(states[1][0]['h'],N)
def exterior(v):return np.array([np.linalg.det(v[[j for j in range(8) if mask>>j&1],:]) for mask in masks])
def exterior_tangent(v,t):
 result=np.zeros(len(masks),complex)
 for j in range(N):
  z=v.copy();z[:,j]=t[:,j];result+=exterior(z)
 return result
for p,e,r in states:
 positive=r[:,N:];negative=r[:,:N];u,s,vh=np.linalg.svd(origin.conj().T@positive);v=positive@vh.conj().T@u.conj().T
 c=positive.conj().T@v;gap=e[None,N:]-e[:N,None];omega=(negative.conj().T@p['hx']@positive)/gap
 t=negative@omega@c;ts=negative@(omega*np.exp(-gap/2))@c
 dgamma,_=alpha.second_quantized(p['h'],N);pref=p['pref'];log0=states[1][0]['pref']+np.sum(states[1][1][N:]);sfull=expm((dgamma+(pref-log0)*np.eye(len(masks)))/2)
 frames.append(v);tangents.append(t);weighted.append(ts);sf.append(sfull);vac.append(exterior(v));direct_t.append(exterior_tangent(v,t))
phi=np.sqrt(w)*np.exp(-width*nodes**2/2);phi/=np.linalg.norm(phi);sea=np.sqrt(2*width)*nodes*phi;aux=-phi/np.sqrt(2*width)
R=np.sqrt(w[:,None]*w[None,:])*np.exp(-(nodes[:,None]-nodes[None,:])**2/(4*ua))/np.sqrt(4*np.pi*ua)
rows=[]
for flavours in (1,2):
 image=[];imageaux=[]
 for i in range(3):
  a=sf[i]@vac[i];t=sf[i]@direct_t[i]
  if flavours==1:q=a;j=t
  else:q=np.kron(a,a);j=np.kron(t,a)+np.kron(a,t)
  image.append(sea[i]*q+aux[i]*j);imageaux.append(aux[i]*j)
 direct=sum(R[i,j]*np.vdot(image[i],image[j]) for i in range(3) for j in range(3)).real
 directaux=sum(R[i,j]*np.vdot(imageaux[i],imageaux[j]) for i in range(3) for j in range(3)).real
 estimate=0j;estimateaux=0j;adverseaux=0j
 for i in range(3):
  for j in range(3):
   m=frames[i].conj().T@frames[j];d=np.linalg.det(m)
   ql=np.linalg.solve(m,weighted[i].conj().T@frames[j]);qr=np.linalg.solve(m,frames[i].conj().T@weighted[j]);qq=np.linalg.solve(m,weighted[i].conj().T@weighted[j])
   factor=np.exp(flavours*((states[i][0]['pref']+np.sum(states[i][1][N:])+states[j][0]['pref']+np.sum(states[j][1][N:]))/2-log0))*d**flavours
   tt=flavours*np.trace(qq-ql@qr)+flavours**2*np.trace(ql)*np.trace(qr)
   estimate+=R[i,j]*factor*(sea[i]*sea[j]+sea[i]*aux[j]*flavours*np.trace(qr)+aux[i]*sea[j]*flavours*np.trace(ql)+aux[i]*aux[j]*tt)
   estimateaux+=R[i,j]*factor*aux[i]*aux[j]*tt
   ql0=np.linalg.solve(m,tangents[i].conj().T@frames[j]);qr0=np.linalg.solve(m,frames[i].conj().T@tangents[j]);qq0=np.linalg.solve(m,tangents[i].conj().T@tangents[j])
   adverseaux+=R[i,j]*factor*aux[i]*aux[j]*(flavours*np.trace(qq0-ql0@qr0)+flavours**2*np.trace(ql0)*np.trace(qr0))
 rows.append(dict(flavours=flavours,fullcanonical_dimension=len(masks)**flavours,actual_fullFock_wholehalf_form=direct,mixedSlater_formula=estimate.real,whole_error=abs(direct-estimate),actual_fullFock_auxiliary_wholehalf_form=directaux,auxiliary_formula=estimateaux.real,auxiliary_error=abs(directaux-estimateaux),adverse_unweighted_SF_auxiliary_form=adverseaux.real))
 if abs(direct-estimate)>1e-11 or abs(directaux-estimateaux)>1e-13:raise ArithmeticError('Mixed fullcanonical derivative identity falsified')
 if abs(adverseaux.real-directaux)<100*abs(directaux-estimateaux):raise ArithmeticError('Adverse missing-SF source price did not discriminate')
result=dict(rows=rows,scope='Exact N1/N2 Slater identity calibration on literal positive2siteC Cartesian70-state n4 sector and tensor4900 states; no truncation of canonicalFock/auxiliary derivative and no polegate. beta100 is calibrationcoordinate parameter, not beta16Nk4 physicalfamily claim.',execution=dict(loop_at_IMPORT=hashlib.sha256(Path(loops.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),alpha_at_IMPORT=alpha.SOURCE_HASHES,python=sys.version,numpy=np.__version__,executable=sys.executable))
